title: Canceling stamps: Peak ticket
summary: Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
Matching cancellation stamps erase each other when they meet at the top of the paper pile. Luz is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement cancelingStampsPeakTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Stack cancellation. Read stamps left to right. If a stamp equals the top stamp, remove that top stamp; otherwise push it. Produce the final stack from bottom to top. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.

The derived sequence is [-2,4]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 4.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.
